data.body:
Phase 2 validation complete

Held-out oracle: GREEN in 1.38s after the fixer; the fixer never saw its fixture, assertions, or path. Defect-seeded mutation removed exactly the private --basetemp pair and returned the oracle to RED at "nested pytest deleted another run temp tree"; restoring the two lines returned the implementation to GREEN. Refactoring litmus: the oracle asserts only real subprocess effects and sentinel bytes/directory state, so private renames/extraction do not affect it.

Focused validation: all four store-isolation cases passed under REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 in 4.38s. Original outer-node replication stressed 30/30 uninterrupted runs, min 1.566s and max 1.849s, with no post-summary stall. make lint passed; make typecheck passed (551 source files). Exact CI-faithful default selection under REBAR_REQUIRE_EXTRAS=1 exited 0: 13,576 passed, 25 skipped, 288 deselected, 20 warnings in 3,674.84s (1:01:14). After pytest reported 100%, session finish returned in <0.5s.

Safety: caller sweep found only the three store-isolation tests and no behavioral dependency on shared temp cleanup. The fix restores isolation, adds no dependency/capability, and weakens no pre-existing assertion. Construct sweep residual filed as asbestos-popular-tench (fb03-2609-ef83-4b41), covering five other nested-pytest launch sites; unbounded repo-isolation Git-probe fragility filed separately as callous-amused-hart (cf0f-2e26-87ca-47a8). Both are linked discovered_from. Parity sweep N/A: this is an internal test helper with no CLI/API/library/mirror surface.
